title: 四个风险组与三步管理

points.K2: 可引发流行，威胁公共卫生
points.K4: 第1组：健康人一般不致病
points.K6: 第3组：病重，但有防治手段
points.K8: 生物风险管理：管住风险
points.K13: 防患于未然，做到生物安全

shots.scene: 欣欣站在门上贴着生物危害标志的实验室前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a lab door with a biohazard warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲风险分组和三步管理。
overlay: 四个风险组与三步管理

shots.scene: 四级台阶图标和三个相连的圆圈图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a four-step staircase and three linked circles side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 先认清风险，再一步步管住它。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一支贴空白标签的菌种管，一脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a culture tube with a blank label and looks at it curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到一支新菌种，想马上开工。

shots.scene: 阿杰问小研，头上冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the female graduate student a question, a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 他问：它危险吗？在哪儿做？

shots.scene: 小研拿出一本空白目录和一张空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes out a blank catalogue book and a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 小研说：先查分组，再做评估。

shots.scene: 放大镜下的细菌和病毒卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over cartoon icons of round bacteria, rod bacteria and spiky virus particles. No people.
shots.narration: 致病的细菌和病毒，

shots.scene: 病原图标旁一个黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The pathogen icons next to a yellow warning triangle with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 会给人带来实实在在的生物风险。

shots.section_title: 可引发流行，威胁公共卫生
shots.scene: 一个病人图标连到几个人，再连到一片城市
shots.prompt_en: A network diagram: one sick person icon connects to several people icons, then to a city skyline icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦传开，可能引起流行。
overlay: 可引发流行，威胁公共卫生

shots.section_title: 可引发流行，威胁公共卫生
shots.scene: 城市图标上罩着一个红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A city skyline icon under a large red exclamation mark, with a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 威胁的是整个社会的公共卫生。

shots.scene: 地球图标旁四个由浅到深的格子
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon next to four boxes in a row, shaded from light to dark. No people.
shots.narration: 国际上把病原体分成四个风险组。

shots.scene: 格子上标出看病情、看传播、看防治的三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons above the boxes: a sick person, spreading arrows, and a medicine capsule with a vaccine vial. No people.
shots.narration: 看病情多重、传不传播、能否防治。

shots.scene: 左边国际四格1最浅，右边国内四类第一类最深
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of four boxes: in the left row the first box is lightest; in the right row the first box is darkest. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：国内分类方向正好相反，

shots.scene: 欣欣指着右边最深的格子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the darkest first box in the right row.
shots.narration: 国内第一类最危险，第四类最低。

shots.section_title: 第1组：健康人一般不致病
shots.scene: 最浅的格子放大，旁边一个健康的笑脸人
shots.prompt_en: The lightest box enlarges, next to a smiling healthy person icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 第1组，一般不会让健康人得病。
overlay: 第1组：健康人一般不致病

shots.section_title: 第1组：健康人一般不致病
shots.scene: 小研戴手套、穿实验服在实验台前操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and gloves works at an open lab bench.
shots.narration: 风险最低，也照样要规范操作。

shots.scene: 第二个格子，旁边一个轻度生病的人和药丸
shots.prompt_en: The second box, next to a person icon with a mild fever and a medicine capsule. No people.
shots.narration: 第2组，能让人生病，

shots.scene: 传播箭头很短，旁边有药品和疫苗图标
shots.prompt_en: Short spreading arrows that stop quickly, with medicine and vaccine icons nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 但危害有限，传播风险低，有办法防治。

shots.section_title: 第3组：病重，但有防治手段
shots.scene: 第三个格子，旁边一个卧床的病人图标
shots.prompt_en: The third box, next to a person icon lying in bed seriously ill. No people.
shots.narration: 第3组，常引起严重疾病，
overlay: 第3组：病重，但有防治手段

shots.section_title: 第3组：病重，但有防治手段
shots.scene: 药品和疫苗图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Medicine and vaccine icons with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 但一般有有效的治疗或预防办法。

shots.scene: 最深的格子，旁边红色骷髅警示图标
shots.prompt_en: The darkest box, next to a red skull warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第4组，可引起致命疾病，

shots.scene: 长长的传播箭头，药品图标被打问号
shots.prompt_en: Long spreading arrows reaching many people icons, and a medicine icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 容易传播，往往缺少有效防治手段。

shots.scene: 四级实验室门图标，门上有锁和印章
shots.prompt_en: A heavily sealed high-containment lab door icon with a lock and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 只能在最高级别的设施里操作。

shots.section_title: 生物风险管理：管住风险
shots.scene: 拼图的几块慢慢拼合成一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Jigsaw puzzle pieces slowly fit together to form a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理，就是把风险管住。
overlay: 生物风险管理：管住风险

shots.section_title: 生物风险管理：管住风险
shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰围着空白白板讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss around a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 这是实验室每个人的事。

shots.scene: 三个相连的圆圈，依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three connected circles light up one after another in a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 管理分三步，连起来是一个循环。

shots.scene: 欣欣在三个圆圈旁伸出三根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers beside the three connected circles.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，简称AMP。

shots.scene: 小研拿空白评估表，看着菌种管和仪器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank risk assessment form, looking at a culture tube and a centrifuge.
shots.narration: 第一步，风险评估：

shots.scene: 评估表上浮出病原、操作、人员、设施四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons float above the form: a microbe, a pipette, a person, and a lab building. No people.
shots.narration: 这东西多危险，我要做什么操作。

shots.scene: 天平图标：可能性和后果两边
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon weighing a dice icon against a red warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 估计出事的可能和后果有多大。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里操作，戴手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a biological safety cabinet wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 第二步，风险减缓：

shots.scene: 安全柜、防护用品、规程本、门禁四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a biological safety cabinet, protective gear, a blank procedure book, and a door access reader. No people.
shots.narration: 用设备、防护和规程，把风险降下来。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表巡查实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第三步，绩效评估：

shots.scene: 检查表上一行行打勾，一行是红叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with rows of green checks and one red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 看措施有没有执行，管不管用。

shots.scene: 箭头从检查表绕回到评估表
shots.prompt_en: A curved arrow loops from the checklist back to the risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 发现问题，就回到第一步改进。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开空白目录，指着一行
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank catalogue book and points at one line.
shots.narration: 开工前，先查国内的病原目录，

shots.scene: 目录里的类别连到不同实验活动图标
shots.prompt_en: Lines connect a category box to different activity icons: a culture flask, a sample tube, and an inactivated sample. No people.
shots.narration: 同一种菌，培养和检测要求不同。

shots.scene: 空白评估表交给生物安全委员会，盖上印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank risk assessment form is passed to a committee table and stamped. No people.
shots.narration: 防护级别由评估确定，经审批才开工。

shots.scene: 阿杰自己开工的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the young male student starting an experiment alone, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 学生不能自己定级、擅自开始。

shots.scene: 罩着纱网的昆虫饲养笼
shots.prompt_en: An insect rearing cage covered with fine mesh net on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 蚊子等媒介昆虫，也能传播病原。

shots.scene: 双层门和纱网门帘，门口有灭虫灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A double door with a mesh curtain and an insect trap light icon at the entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 饲养间要双层门、纱网，防止逃逸。

shots.scene: 小研在空白记录本上清点数量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student counts insect cages and writes in a blank record book.
shots.narration: 定期清点，发现逃逸立即报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰差点碰倒样品架，小研扶住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nearly knocks over a sample rack; the female graduate student catches it.
shots.narration: 差点出事，也是一次提醒。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白报告单上填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fills in a blank incident report form.
shots.narration: 险兆事件要如实记录上报。

shots.scene: 报告单汇集到王老师手里，变成改进清单
shots.prompt_en: Several blank report forms gather in the safety administrator's hands and turn into a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 上报不是追责，是为了找漏洞。

shots.section_title: 防患于未然，做到生物安全
shots.scene: 一只手挡住传播箭头
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon blocks a chain of spreading arrows before they reach a city icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把风险挡在实验室里，
overlay: 防患于未然，做到生物安全

shots.section_title: 防患于未然，做到生物安全
shots.scene: 实验室全体人员站在盾牌后
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand behind a large shield icon.
shots.narration: 防患于未然，人人做到生物安全。

shots.scene: 高等级防护实验室外观和负压示意
shots.prompt_en: A high-containment laboratory building with airflow arrows pointing inward at the doors. No people.
shots.narration: 合格的防护设施，是重要保障。

shots.scene: 老李检查设施，旁边空白检测合格标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a containment lab facility next to a blank certification tag.
shots.narration: 但再好的设施，也要人按规程用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁四个格子，两排方向相反
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two rows of four boxes shaded in opposite directions.
shots.narration: 国际四组看危害，国内方向相反。

shots.scene: 三个循环圆圈和目录图标
shots.prompt_en: Three looping circles next to a blank catalogue book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，查目录再定级。

shots.scene: 昆虫笼和报告单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a mesh insect cage and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 防昆虫逃逸，险兆也要上报。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 先懂风险，再管风险，下次见！
